metadata.description: Spec-driven development for Claude Code: delivery workflow, feature diagrams, design-system prototypes and Figma layout

plugins.name: sdd-kit
plugins.description: Spec-driven delivery for any software project (web, mobile, backend): discovery, spec with How-it-works diagrams, plan, TDD implementation with two-verdict review, verification and a draft PR, behind three human gates.

plugins.name: sdd-diagrams
plugins.description: Every feature gets a How-it-works diagram: checks the Mermaid in a spec and renders editorial SVG, a multi-page draw.io file and a review gallery.

plugins.name: sdd-design
plugins.description: Clickable prototypes from an approved spec, built only from your own design system, plus a starter for a separate design-system repository.

plugins.name: sdd-figma
plugins.description: Lays out a feature's diagrams and prototype screens in Figma as auto-layout frames bound to design-system variables, through the Figma MCP connector or a bundled Figma plugin.
